Name: Fancy Artisan Goods Icons BAGI Pack
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia][color=#fce5cd][size=3] [center] ﻿THIS MOD IS FOR STARDEW 1.5.6 AND BELOW ONLY! 
IF YOU WANT TO USE IT FOR STARDEW 1.6 - DOWNLOAD [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23373]THIS 1.6 VESION FROM HERE[/url]﻿﻿ AND MAKE SURE TO LOOK INTO IT'S REQUIRED MOD DEPENDENCIDES![/center][center]------------------------------[/center]

A whole [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url] pack to match [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12766]Fancy Artisan Goods Retexture mod.[/url] 
[/size][/color]
[size=2]Simply makes  jelly, pickles,honey, wine, mead and juice icons look be based on the fruit, vegetable, or flower used to make them. The mead icons will apply automatically when the [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads mod[/url][size=2] and [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11911]Better Mead Icons - BAGI Addon [/url][size=2] is installed.[/size]


[color=#ff7700][size=3][u][b]Supported retextures:[/b][/u][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower meads[/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13780]Fruit Tree Honey[/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Starder Valley Expanded[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ (only jelly and wine)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4472]Ancient Crops[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking [/url]﻿﻿﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5976]Winter Crops[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3568]Lucky Clover [/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4679?tab=description]Sweet Gem Fruit[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13869]﻿Octopetalas[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10224305]Korea Blossom﻿[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http:///www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15107]Quaint Living - Flower Garden[/url]﻿﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7784]Lumisteria More Pickled Products[/url] (read the installation guide for this one!)[/size]﻿[/font]
[/list]
[u][color=#ff7700][size=3][b]Installation﻿:
[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Install Better Artisan Good Icons[/url][/size][/font]

[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Put ﻿all the folders (or separate ones you need) from  mod archive into your Mods folder[/size][/font]
[/list][size=2][u][color=#ffff00]
[/color][/u][u][color=#ff7700]For Lumisteria More Pickled Products:[/color][/u][/size]

[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Locate and open "[JA] [PFM] Lumisteria More Pickled Products" mod folder on this path:[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Stardew Valley\Mods\[JA] [PFM] Lumisteria More Pickled Products[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Drag "[JA] Lumisteria More Pickled Products" folder from my mod's archive into "[JA] [PFM] Lumisteria More Pickled Products" mod folder, confirm the file replacement[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Done! [/size][/font](you'll need to do this after every time you update Lumisteria mod).
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=2][u]For Octopetalas:[/u][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Octopetalas already have it's own BAGI retextures in it's folder and it will overlap my retextures, so you need to delete it first:[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Go to Octopetalas mod folder and delete the "Octopetala Honey and Mead" folder completely.[/size][/font]
[/list][color=#fce5cd][size=2]Most of retextures will apply automatically if the supported mod is installed
[/size][/color]
[color=#fce5cd][size=2][u]For flower meads and Korea Blossom you also need to install those mods:[/u][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads mod[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1] [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11911][size=1]Better Mead Icons - BAGI Addon[/size][/url][/font]
[/list][color=#d98f40][size=2]
[/size][/color][color=#fce5cd][size=2][u]For Octopetalas and vanilla fruit tree honeys and meads you need those mods:[/u][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11911]Better Mead Icons - BAGI Addon[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11911][/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13780]Fruit Tree Honey[/url][/size][/font]
[/list]

[color=#ff7700][size=3][u][b]FAQ:
[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Technically this mod is reupload of my old [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12732]Fancy Artisan Goods Fix for Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url]﻿ mod, but I improved it and decided to make it into new mod entirely. [/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]there most probably won't be retextures for PPJA (there's too many to do, sorry)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]some other relatively  small mods support will be probably added in the future[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]f you'll find bugs, please tell in the comments[/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=3][u][b]Credits:[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Used Jelly, Pickles, Mead, Honey sprites from [url=http://henrysoftware.itch.io/godot-pixel-food]HenrySoftware's free food asset pack  [/url][/size][/font]
[*]Honeys and Jellies for Octopetalas﻿, Honeys for Korea Blossom are made by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/users/32616660]Runzu87[/url]﻿ (thank you a lot!)
[*][font=Georgia][size=1]Most of the color palletes I used are from all those mods listed above [/size][/font]
[/list][/font]
[font=Georgia][color=#fff2cc][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=3][center][/center][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/color][/font]
